id: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \rTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.
\rHo catturato i miei Pokémon con May.

id: \bI think we've spent enough time making clothes for the Pokémon here. Time to head home.
en: \bI think we've spent enough time making clothes for the Pokémon here. Time to head home.
it: \bCredo che abbiamo passato abbastanza tempo a fare vestiti per i Pokémon di qui. È ora di tornare a casa.

id: \bBurgh: Hello there. It seems my Leavanny has taken a liking to you.
en: \bBurgh: Hello there. It seems my Leavanny has taken a liking to you.
it: \bArtemisio: Salve. Sembra che il mio Leavanny ti abbia preso in simpatia.

id: \bMy name is Burgh. And yours? \PN. What a nice name.
en: \bMy name is Burgh. And yours? \PN. What a nice name.
it: \bMi chiamo Artemisio. E tu? \PN. Che bel nome.

id: \bSo what is a young Trainer like you doing in the forest? You're heading to Castelia City for a Gym battle.
en: \bSo what is a young Trainer like you doing in the forest? You're heading to Castelia City for a Gym battle.
it: \bAllora, cosa ci fa un giovane Allenatore come te nel bosco? Stai andando ad Austropoli per una lotta in Palestra.

id: \bSounds exciting. I can assure you the gym will give you a run for your money.
en: \bSounds exciting. I can assure you the gym will give you a run for your money.
it: \bChe emozione. Ti assicuro che la Palestra ti darà del filo da torcere.

id: \bWe should be going now. It was a pleasure to meet you, \PN.
en: \bWe should be going now. It was a pleasure to meet you, \PN.
it: \bOra dobbiamo andare. È stato un piacere conoscerti, \PN.

id: \bAre you going into the deeper area?
en: \bAre you going into the deeper area?

id: \bBe careful. It can get crazy in there.
en: \bBe careful. It can get crazy in there.
it: \bFai attenzione. Là dentro può diventare una follia.

id: \rWhat do you think of the forest?
en: \rWhat do you think of the forest?

id: \rI really like it in here. It's mystic.
en: \rI really like it in here. It's mystic.
it: \rMi piace davvero tanto qui. È mistico.

id: \bBurgh is over there somewhere. A nobody like you shouldn't disturb him.
en: \bBurgh is over there somewhere. A nobody like you shouldn't disturb him.
it: \bArtemisio è da qualche parte laggiù. Una nullità come te non dovrebbe disturbarlo.

id: \bYou met Burgh?! What was he like?
en: \bYou met Burgh?! What was he like?

id: \bDon't go in there. A powerful Pokémon dwells there.
en: \bDon't go in there. A powerful Pokémon dwells there.
it: \bNon entrare lì. Ci dimora un Pokémon potente.

id: \rI hear a powerful Pokémon lives in here.
en: \rI hear a powerful Pokémon lives in here.
it: \rHo sentito che qui vive un Pokémon potente.

id: Would you like to take Sewaddle with you?
en: Would you like to take Sewaddle with you?
